name: Pig-at-arms (Braum)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Base champion: Braum

Skin:  Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-Shield that transforms!

-Absolutely not references to Darkest Dunegon.

-The prior feature is a lie.


__________

Legacy changelog:
1.0.0; 3-02-2025
First release of the mod.

1.1.0; 30-09-2026
-Fixed voiceover (tested only in english language).
-Fixed sound in emotes.
-Fixed homeguard animation not showing up unless the back-to-base animation is completed before moving.
__________

Lore:

When the Vindicator brothers arrived to the Nether, they realized they had commited a terrible mistake: no one of them knew a sh*t about that dimension. They were supposed to search for a place called "The Darkest Fortress" and retrieve a dangerous artifact from it, but even finding the fortress would be impossible. Luckily for them, they met a friendly piglin that knows the place and loves traveling in groups of four while exploring dungeons!

__________

Sources and references:

-Rig and model made mostly by me (some specific parts are extracted from Minecraft).

-All animations made by me.

-Particle effects mostly made by me.

-The dance emote references campings in Darkest Dungeon, with the same music ("A Brief Respite" from its OST).

-The laugh emote references the old video "Cacamod" by the spanish youtuber Alexelcapo.

-The voiceover uses the voice of Wayne June, who played The Ancestor in Darkest Dungeon, and sadly passed away in january of 2025. I considered making a specific emote as a tribute, but all emote sockets were already occupied when this was revealed.

-Special Thanks to Bud for helping with the render (this has become a tradition by now).
